Sorry-free probe against the live FrameOver/WorldHistory/PlusTruthAt/StarTruthAt/CTruthAt: product frame with each field's hypothesis isolated, history lift/projection, L/L+/L* invariance, class-validity equality at every tag, frame-level non-reflection, HistMap/HistMorphism, clocked factorization, coarse-model lift and paste-closure transfer.

Sorry-free Mathlib-only mirror: fixing the zero task to equality changes no history or truth value (given reflexivity), and the clocked zero-fixed relation satisfies Limit; Limit is idle beyond reflexivity of the zero task.

memory_candidates.content: Class validity of L, L+ and L* over any FrameClass tag equals validity over the recurrence-free (clocked) members: every task frame is covered by its translation product F x D (same duration group), which is a task frame at every FrameOver field, with Limit needing only the zero task to be contained in the identity. Frame-by-frame validity is NOT reflected (clock-dependent valuations on the product are the abundant two-dimensional models).

The morphism notion under which PlusTruthAt is invariant is a history-lifting morphism: relation-level forth, history-level lift through every preimage state (for the stability clause), and onto histories (for box). Relation-level bounded morphisms lift one task, not a total history; the projection from the translation product is the canonical instance.
